class.name: HaxeScript

method.name: load_source_code
method.description: Reads the Haxe source at [param path] and parses it. Returns [constant OK] when the file was read and its native base class could be resolved, [constant ERR_CANT_OPEN] when the file cannot be opened, or another error code when the source does not parse. The exported members and the native base class are updated from the new source. The script loader calls this automatically when the script's path is set; calling it by hand re-reads the file after an external change.
